Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 33

“But if you will not fight this righteous battle, then, having abandoned your own duty and your honour, you will incur wrong.”

The counter-case. Krishna insists that withdrawal is not neutral — refusing carries its own moral cost. Arjuna has been treating retreat as the safely blameless option, and it is not.
